cand.title: Toronto Breast Imaging Conference 2027
cand.organizationName: University of Toronto Temerty Faculty of Medicine Continuing Professional Development

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Priority organizational contacts: Nancy Carey, Associate Director, Conference Management; Ann-Marie Rasiawan, Conference Planner. Both roles and work emails are published in the CPD directory, but neither is publicly assigned specifically to TBIC 2027 or proven to control its hotel contract. Event-specific academic contacts: co-directors Supriya Kulkarni and Derek Muradali; chairs Kartik S. Jhaveri and Michael N. Patlas. They provide programme sponsorship/routing relevance, not demonstrated accommodation-buying authority.
findings.futureEdition: Official conference homepage announces Saturday, May 1, 2027, hybrid in-person/online: a one-day activity within the requested horizon. No later edition through June 2028 was located. This is an activity date, not a publication date. Caution: the homepage also retains 2026 topic highlights and 10th-anniversary copy, while fees pages retain 2025 cancellation terms; do not treat those details as the 2027 programme.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: conditional city-hotel fit, not a resort programme. Radisson Blu’s 157 rooms could support a modest speaker/VIP or out-of-town delegate subset if actual demand exists; no room count can be estimated from the evidence. Chestnut is the announced meeting location, so this is not presently a whole-conference relocation or confirmed local-catering opportunity. Hybrid, one-day delivery weakens the case for substantial overnight demand. For a future edition, assess the 240-theatre ballroom limit, workshop layout, AV and catering operation before proposing a venue move. No evidence establishes that the event is too large or too small for this hotel.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Chestnut Conference Center, 89 Chestnut Street, Toronto, Ontario M5G 1R1, Canada. In Toronto proper, downtown near Nathan Phillips Square, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The current venue page carries the May 1, 2027 heading and explicitly lists Chestnut. Treat as the announced venue, not proof of an executed contract; obtain edition-specific reconfirmation because the website contains rolled-forward historical content. Chestnut is a university conference/residence facility, not a conventional competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified Toronto venue changes: April 27, 2019 — Women’s College Hospital Conference Centre; May 25, 2024 — Hilton Toronto; May 10, 2025 — Omni King Edward Hotel; May 9, 2026 — Chestnut Conference Center. An April 23, 2022 edition is listed by Medical Imaging without venue in the retrieved evidence. May 13, 2023 symposium activity is preserved on a mixed-year page; its hotel footer cannot safely establish the 2023 venue. Evidence supports a repeat Toronto series and changes between university/hospital and hotel venues, not a documented geographic rotation or guaranteed annual recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for 2027. No edition-specific housing bureau, hotel block, booking code, open accommodation RFP, room-night commitment or overflow arrangement was located. The venue page says “Chestnut Conference Center 89 Chestnut St Toronto ON M5G 1R1”; it does not advertise a lodging block. The 2026 speaker page directs session materials to “CPD Conference Services (cpd.confserv@utoronto.ca)”, an organizer routing channel, not proof of hotel procurement authority. Hotels verified as historical meeting venues are Hilton Toronto (2024) and Omni King Edward Hotel (2025); neither is a verified 2027 lodging incumbent. Every verified 2027 room-block hotel: none found.
findings.organizationStructure: University-led medical continuing professional development conference: CPD, Temerty Faculty of Medicine, University of Toronto, with Department of Medical Imaging academic leadership. This is not an independent trade association, corporate incentive programme or identified external PCO/DMC. CPD has an internal Conference Management Services team; its published services include “Site selection and venue contracting” and “vendor procurement”. That establishes organizational capability, not the identity of the assigned 2027 buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The announced Chestnut venue already occupies the main-meeting position. Historical hotel hosts demonstrate hotel-venue competition but do not establish current lodging exclusivity. Chestnut advertises seasonal university-residence accommodation generally; that is not a TBIC booking commitment. No sellout, capacity shortage, displaced delegates, waitlist, contracted overflow or confirmed room demand was found. Radisson Blu must not be presented as an official or needed overflow hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nancy Carey first at nancy.carey@utoronto.ca; request the assigned TBIC 2027 planner and confirmation that May 1/Chestnut are final. Ask whether CPD arranges faculty travel or attendee lodging, whether any hotel/residence commitments exist, and whether an unallocated small lodging requirement remains. Ann-Marie Rasiawan (annmarie.rasiawan@utoronto.ca) is a secondary planner-routing contact, not an assumed buyer. If there is no 2027 need, request the next venue-review date and programme requirements. Offer a conditional site inspection only after confirming in-person numbers, workshop configuration, AV and the hotel’s catering availability.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 meeting/catering access is constrained by the published Chestnut venue. Accommodation access remains unconfirmed, not open and not proven committed elsewhere. A permission-based inquiry about faculty travel and any unallocated delegate lodging is appropriate; a room-block or catering quote without buyer confirmation would be premature.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: hotel-hosted editions in 2024 and 2025 make a future Toronto venue bid plausible, despite the move to Chestnut in 2026 and its publication for 2027. No 2028 date, venue-selection window or open RFP was located. Develop an internal CPD relationship and request future venue criteria rather than label 2028 as confirmed business.
